name: Vaeloria

magic.description: Residue of the Weavers' Concord, the lost age of high magic. True magic is scarce; most folk never see it. Those born with the Glimmer are feared, hidden, or conscripted. Scholarship on it is forbidden in most realms.

months.name: Frostweep
months.note: Deep cold; veils are hung for the dead.

months.name: Thawtide
months.note: Rivers wake; thaw-fairs across the heartland.

months.name: Bloommorn
months.note: First planting; festivals of the Verdant.

months.name: Greensong
months.note: Fields sing; crowning of the harvest queens.

months.name: Highsun
months.note: Longest days; pilgrimages to Solvane's high temples.

months.name: Goldharvest
months.note: First reaping; tax day across most realms.

months.name: Duskfall
months.note: Leaf-fire nights; the Glimmer is said to stir.

months.name: Mistshroud
months.note: Fog thickens; no caravan travels the old roads.

months.name: Firstfrost
months.note: Quiet begins; hearths are blessed against the cold.

months.name: Hearthwane
months.note: Indoor season; sagas are told by the fire.

months.name: Stilleven
months.note: A week of silence observed; Mornath's vigil.

months.name: Darkveil
months.note: Year's end; the Veil grows thin.

currency.name: bit
currency.note: Common coin of the common folk.

currency.name: shard
currency.note: Standard wage of a skilled laborer per week.

currency.name: sun
currency.note: Rare; used for land, war, and tribute.

common_languages.name: Old Weaver
common_languages.note: Language of the lost Concord; writing it is illegal in most realms.

common_languages.name: Hollow Sign
common_languages.note: Silent trade tongue of the desert folk.

notes: Trademark-free heroic fantasy: original deities, calendar, and cosmology.
Magic is rare and feared; the age is post-apocalyptic in a slow, heroic way — ruins everywhere, glory in the past.
Structure is intentionally a skeleton; flesh out cities, regions, and deities in subsequent work.
